research.title: What makes a legal stablecoin trustworthy
research.answer: Under the GENIUS Act there is no single stamp that makes a stablecoin "trusted": the issuer's approval, the coin's code and keys, its reserves, the platforms selling it and the fixes for mistakes each have to be proven separately.
